title: Integration Developer
summary: An integration developer connects a company's separate systems, such as its CRM, ERP and online store, so that data flows between them through APIs and automated flows. They work in an integration or middleware team, building on platforms like MuleSoft or Boomi with architects, application teams and testers.
dailyDuties: Build APIs and integration flows from mapping specs
Map and transform JSON and XML data between systems
Connect to REST and SOAP services, databases and queues
Deploy integrations through the build pipeline
Fix failed messages and production integration errors
Write API specs and unit tests for each flow

skills.expectation: Build and deploy APIs and flows on an integration platform such as MuleSoft or Boomi
Build and deploy APIs and flows on an integration platform such as MuleSoft or Boomi
Design, build and consume REST APIs
Consume SOAP services and map XML and JSON payloads
Query source and target databases while mapping data
Deploy integrations through Maven and Jenkins or similar pipelines
Write custom Java components when the platform falls short
Use JMS, Kafka or similar queues for async flows
Write unit tests for flows and mappings

certifications.why: MuleSoft developer postings in India often require this certification.
Useful for teams that build on Boomi instead of MuleSoft.
